NHM / FROZEN RESEARCH EVIDENCE

ML research evidence

Read-only, non-diagnostic research summaries. This page does not run a model or change the monitoring runtime.

V2-007 / HISTORICAL MODEL PROMOTION GATE
MODEL_V2_NOT_PROMOTED_RELEASE_CI
PREDECLARED PAIRED RELEASE-SEED CI

Promotion eligible: false. The release-seed paired AUPRC-delta confidence interval [-0.052370174725249, 0.5310360993345348] crossed zero. This historical negative finding remains true.

V2-REL-001 / LATER RESEARCH SOFTWARE RELEASE
SYSTEM_V2_RESEARCH_DEFAULT_ACCEPTED
Decision: true

Current research software default: SOFTWARE_SYSTEM_V2 (MODEL_V2_FINAL). Different questions; the later software decision does not rewrite the earlier model-promotion result.

01 / MODEL LINEAGE
Centrally trained released default

MODEL_V2_FINAL is centrally trained, not a federated checkpoint. Checkpoint SHA256: 89418edcc2c13f0edd9a36666bac560ad922dd4700b4b6dd19b56d067d4eff9b.

MODEL_V1 remains the historical reference and explicit rollback lineage, not the current operational default.

02 / CALIBRATION
CAL_V2 source-domain calibration

MIT-BIH SOURCE-DOMAIN CALIBRATION ONLY. Domain: MIT-BIH-v1.0.0. Temperature: 52.88261929727761. Threshold: 0.5101937262006424. Calibrated ECE: 0.1720347716359628.

No cross-domain, wearable, personal, or clinical calibration is established.

03 / POST-FREEZE
Second-look / runtime evidence

V2-010 runtime acceptance: ACCEPTED. INTERNAL_TEST did not participate in the hard runtime decision (false). INTERNAL_TEST and INCART metrics below are POST-FREEZE SECOND-LOOK / RUNTIME EVIDENCE, not untouched validation.

The small INTERNAL_TEST contributing-group limitation is listed below. INCART is external-domain, project-exposed second-look evidence.

04 / LIMITATIONS
Negative findings remain visible
MODEL_V2_NOT_PROMOTED_RELEASE_CI remains true: the release-seed paired VALIDATION CI lower bound crossed zero; permanent historical negative finding, not rewritten
INTERNAL_TEST has only six eligible contributing patient groups
V2-010 INTERNAL_TEST/INCART/NSTDB evidence is post-freeze second-look evidence, not untouched validation
INCART FL evaluation is project-exposed external second-look evidence
QUALITY_V1 does not reliably hard-fail a raw stuck-nonzero ECG source because of the frozen preprocessing composition (not repaired here)
CAL_V2 is MIT-BIH source-domain calibration only
No physical wearable validation exists
SecAgg evidence is a narrow protected-aggregation-interface result, not a complete privacy guarantee
CLEAN_CLONE_GATING_V1 excluded raw-data-dependent tests from the clean-software claim when their untracked inputs were absent

No physical wearable validation exists. QUALITY_V1 retains the known stuck-nonzero limitation. SecAgg supports only a narrow protected-aggregation-interface claim.

NHM / FROZEN RESEARCH EVIDENCE

FL research evidence

Read-only scientific research summaries, separate from the current product federation engineering demo. The federation clients are logical clients on one laptop, not hospitals or institutions.

V2-FL-001 / IID FEDAVG
Frozen validation result

Initial AUPRC: 0.25769234928353735; best validation AUPRC: 0.8669476403992936 at round 38. V2-minus-V1 paired AUPRC result: 0.36072579405513583 [0.1750145605302984, 0.4563441637280621]. These are frozen validation-selection facts, not a new evaluation.

V2-FL-002 / NON-IID
Synthetic research partitions

IID, LABEL, QUANTITY, FEATURE and COMBINED conditions use synthetic research partitions, not institutions. Values are descriptive; not all differences are statistically significant.

V2-FL-003 / FEDPROX
Mixed transfer, no general promotion

FEDPROX_MU_V2 = 0.1 was the selected frozen configuration. Transfer was mixed; FedProx was NOT promoted as a generally superior method.

V2-FL-EVAL-001 / ONE-SHOT
Held-out FL-lineage evidence

INTERNAL_TEST: FL-LINEAGE HELD-OUT (not project-globally unseen) (6 eligible contributing groups). Frozen V2 FedAvg IID AUPRC: 0.9989312905254022 [0.9961825883847816, 0.9999514139968478], nominal 95% patient-cluster interval. It was held out from V2 FL development, but not globally unseen by the project.

INCART: POST-FREEZE EXTERNAL FL SECOND-LOOK -- NOT PROJECT-BLIND. Frozen V2 FedAvg IID AUPRC: 0.9766042635693575 [0.9437761642879596, 0.993642404149773], nominal 95% patient-cluster interval. This is post-freeze/project-exposed external-domain second-look evidence.

Frozen evaluation rule: Raw `sigmoid(raw_logit)`, threshold 0.5 (`>=`, `FL_EVAL_RAW_THRESHOLD_0P5_V1`), PER_WINDOW_ZSCORE_V1 → float32 [1,2500]; **no CAL_V1/CAL_V2/temperature/threshold fitting; CALIBRATION not accessed**. Patient-cluster bootstrap B=2000, seed 20260927, PCG64, multiplicity preserved (6 slots/replicate INTERNAL_TEST; 32 INCART), no redraw, shared draws for every model and paired contrast; draws reproduce the frozen T018/T020 npz exactly; nominal 95% percentile CIs, no p-values, no multiplicity adjustment. One orchestration command, one guarded invocation per dataset (guards COMPLETED; a second begin raises `ALREADY_CONSUMED`; historical guards untouched).

This page does not reconstruct a threshold or compare the raw-sigmoid FL F1 to CAL_V2-thresholded results.

V2-FL-004 / SECAGG+
Protected aggregation interface only

Within the configured Flower SecAgg+ controlled simulation, the protected application-level server aggregation interface does not receive an individual participating client's clear model-update array while forming the aggregate, and the protected aggregate matches the unprotected reference within the predeclared numerical tolerance.

Plain clear updates: 8; protected clear updates: 0; masked vectors visible: 8. The authoritative product aggregation remains PLAIN; SecAgg is a round-1 shadow.

Overhead accounting: aggregation protocol only; local training excluded. Application payload bytes are not exact network bytes (false). No end-to-end deployment latency was measured.

Unsupported claims include: anonymity, differential privacy, model-inversion resistance, membership-inference resistance, malicious-client resistance, transport security, TLS guarantees, authentication, authorization, OS/process isolation, host isolation, HIPAA compliance, hospital privacy, institution-scale security, production security certification. This is not differential privacy, anonymity, hospital privacy, TLS assurance, or production-security certification.

ENGINEERING DEMO SEPARATION
V2-FL-005 is not scientific efficacy

The current product federation demo derives from V2-FL-005 engineering lineage. It is not part of the five scientific evidence phases above. No synthetic demo accuracy is reported here. See Federation →

NHM / ABOUT
About this prototype
01 / SCOPE
What this is - and is not
NHM is a research prototype for physiological monitoring and federated model development. It is not diagnostic and not a medical device.
Hardware today is SIMULATED ONLY (virtual wearable, WEARABLE_SIM_V1). No physical wearable is connected. A real wearable is a future source adapter that requires verification.
Inference is server-side: MODEL_V2_FINAL in SOFTWARE_SYSTEM_V2. Nothing runs on a sensor.
The waveform is a simulated source ECG. A PPG waveform is unavailable in the current simulator; SpO2/PPG-derived context is shown where the backend emits it.
The engineering federation runtime is enabled. It runs eight logical, synthetic research clients (not hospitals or institutions) on one demonstration machine; each performs genuine local optimization and the coordinator receives model updates rather than local examples.
In a connected (Clerk) live run only, one existing synthetic client, SIM_FL_SITE_00, is shown as MY EDGE CLIENT - a presentation binding to the signed-in owner. Its training data is still synthetic engineering data: your physiology does not train any model, no personal or personalized model exists, and monitoring sessions are never federation data.
A federation run produces an engineering candidate that stays in a sandbox. It is never automatically deployed and does not replace the released MODEL_V2_FINAL.
Monitoring states are research outputs, not health assessments.
